problem.title: IMLS-SLAM KITTI Odom seq 03 full (801 frames): held-out check of the paper pipeline
problem.question: Does the IMLS-SLAM paper pipeline, with the values chosen on seq 07 (00 held out), stay near the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry error (official RTE) on seq 03?

variants.label: IMLS-SLAM paper odometry, window of 100 raw scans, 0.22 deg beam correction
variants.intent: The paper's pipeline and KITTI settings (Sec. V-VI): raw scans with the 0.22 deg vertical-angle correction, the last 100 localized raw scans as the model, h = 0.06 m, r = 0.20 m with a per-query normal, nine planarity-weighted lists of 100 samples walked with the r gate, 20 iterations.

variants.label: IMLS-SLAM paper odometry, window 100, coarse start on the first registration
variants.intent: As paper_odometry_w100, plus one coarse stage (r = 1.0 m, h = 0.3 m, 10 iterations) before the paper's iterations on the first registration only, where the constant-velocity guess is zero. Not in the paper; it matters only for sequences that start in motion (KITTI 04: 11.9 -> 0.43 %).
